third_party_evaluations.summary: Foundational understanding of Azure cloud services, pricing, and security.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 1, introductory: 2. The ordered median is introductory. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded cloud services, pricing and security basics with no experience fit cloud literacy; vendor proctoring and a foundational hint do not demonstrate entry engineering practice.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded Azure services, pricing and security concepts provide foundational cloud knowledge. Zero experience and a limited entry hiring signal leave operations capability unproven.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded services, pricing and security fundamentals are cloud literacy with no experience requirement. Proctoring and modern subject matter do not establish entry engineering execution.
